name: Fenserika
backstory: Was to be married into the Salthos house once, a match called off without explanation the season before the wedding - the whole reason, some say, that Forliamus's guards ever rode the transit route at all.

experience.text: Had a child with Darius, named Darika.
Heard that Niemus and Darius now have a child, Niemius.
Had a child with Nierius, named Fenrius.
Heard that Nakus and Niemus now have a child, Niekus.
Heard that Nierius and Magus now have a child, Nieragus.
Had a child with Darnus, named Fenarnus.
Heard that Darika and Darnakus now have a child, Darnarika.
Heard that Dorakus and Darnus now have a child, Doraknus.
Heard that Dorukus and Fenrius now have a child, Fenriukas.
Had a child with Nakoran, named Nakorika.
Heard that Dornakus and Darika now have a child, Dornarika.
Heard that Dornakus and Fenrius now have a child, Dornarius.
Heard that Nieragus and Dorakus now have a child, Nieradus.
Had a child with Niekus, named Fenekus.

criterion.standard: counts a plain answer, sealed or refused, above another wedding that just quietly stops being spoken of
criterion.wasted_life: watching this house do to someone else exactly what it did to her - quietly let it die instead of ever saying why
criterion.origin: collision between her backstory (her own broken match to the Salthos house) and the sample's own forliamus_betrothal_offer (a new betrothal offered between the same two houses)
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

previous.standard: counts what actually happened above whichever house's version is more convenient
previous.wasted_life: watching two ledgers argue over a year she actually lived through, and never once being asked what she remembers
previous.origin: collision between her backstory (the broken match at the center of CONFLICT-01) and the conflict itself

history.note: re-derived after encodings.json gained three new concrete concepts (crossing_market_roof, toll_ledger_arrears, forliamus_betrothal_offer) via /tell, at the author's explicit direction, to diversify arcs away from the epistemic-conflict default

routines.routine_actions: waits near the Salthos house's own square on petition days, has asked three times now for someone to explain plainly why the match was called off, and has never gotten a straight answer

arc.premise: With the Forliamus betrothal finally spoken of in the open, Fenserika's turned the same demand on the toll shortfall - she wants Gorff's arrears named plainly at the square and settled, not managed quietly the way her own marriage once was.
